messages:
Maya: heads up we saw a p95 spike on the continuous-batcher this morning, looks like small-batch churn.
Arjun: where? prod-us-west model:gpt-13b-v0?
Maya: yep, around 03:12 UTC. perf-bot alerted: p95 jumped to 2.3s, throughput down 22%.
perf-bot: ALERT: p95 latency 2300ms > 2000ms | service=continuous-batcher | model=gpt-13b-v0 | region=us-west
Kai: I pulled profiler samples during the window, attaching top stacks.
Kai: sampled stacks show heavy time in kernel_selector -> fallback_kernel_for_short_seqs
Maya: KV cache hitrate dropped from 98% to 68% at the same time.
Sienna: any config changes? autoscaler? admission?
Arjun: not intentionally. Autoscaler bumped nodes for increased QPS, but scheduler admission policy had a recent tweak: small_batch_threshold reduced from 16 -> 8 (PR #4021)
Maya: that PR might be causing the feedback loop: smaller microbatches -> more requests -> higher kv cache churn -> cache misses -> kernel fallback -> increased latency -> more admissions -> etc.
Kai: prof output snippet:
```
# top 5 stacks (sampled)
1) runtime_loop -> schedule_batches -> pick_kernel(short_seq)  (42%)
2) kv_cache::lookup_miss -> refill_kv -> memory_copy (18%)
3) cudnn_conv_fallback -> slower_path (12%)
```
Kai: also saw kernel selector logs:
`selected_kernel=fast_seq_opt_v1 on seq_len=12` then later `fallback_kernel=generic_v2 on seq_len=12` (indicates fallback)
Arjun: can we roll back small_batch_threshold to 16 for canary? Also maybe increase kv_cache_shard_count temporarily.
Maya: I'm going to revert the admission tweak in staging and run replay. If it reproduces, we'll roll back in prod.
Sienna: add a perf regression ticket and link PRs: INF-723
Maya: created INF-723 with initial notes + profile dump.
Arjun: quick mitigation: pin kernel_selector to avoid fallback for short seqs (hotfix) while we investigate.
Kai: running a replay now against staging dataset (10k reqs) with reverted threshold and increased shards.
perf-bot: NOTE: deployment redwood/continuous-batcher v1.9.3 -> v1.9.4 initiated by Maya
Maya: staging run shows p95 back to ~420ms, kv hitrate 96%.
Arjun: good. schedule rollback in prod for 15:00 UTC, coordinate with oncall.
Sienna: added postmortem checklist items: monitor kv hitrate, kernel-fallback rate, small-batch admission metric.
Maya: thanks all. Follow-ups: INF-723 assign to Kai for deeper kernel selector root cause, Arjun for admission heuristics, Sienna to update monitoring dashboards.
Kai: noted. Will dump sampling profiles and kernel selection traces to the ticket.
Maya: closing thread, will post updates to the incident channel if anything changes :thumbsup:
